description: Two logic gates in 2HP, each taking four inputs through AND, OR or XOR, with an invert button that turns them into NAND, NOR and XNOR

params.text: Chooses that section's operation: AND, OR or XOR
Inverts that section's result while it is red, making AND into NAND, OR into NOR and XOR into XNOR

inputs.text: One of the four signals that section compares, counted as high at 1V or more; an unpatched jack is left out of the comparison

outputs.text: Carries 10V while that section's comparison is true and 0V while it is false

notes: OR and XOR work off a count of high inputs: OR is true at or above the count and XOR is true at exactly the count, and the count is 1 unless you raise it on the menu
a red light above the XOR label shows that the count has been moved off 1; the menu is the only place the number itself is shown
menu: A: OR min count/XOR exact count, B: OR min count/XOR exact count: 1 (default), 2, 3, 4 — sets how many inputs of that section must be high, and is ignored in AND mode
Input A1, Input A2, Input A3, Input A4, Input B1, Input B2, Input B3, Input B4: Normal, Inverted — inverts that one input before the comparison, and lights a small red mark beside its jack
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Gate-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming gate counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Gate-high output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while high, 10V unless you change it
Gate-low output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while low, 0V unless you change it
